# AUDIT FINDING TEMPLATE

- **Finding ID**: SEC-XXX / REL-XXX / DEBT-XXX
- **Severity**: CRITICAL / HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW
- **Affected Component**: Component name
- **Source File**: Exact file path and line number
- **Evidence**: Source code excerpt
- **Impact**: Security or reliability consequence
- **Recommended Correction**: Code or architectural change needed
- **Verification Status**: Verified in code / Requires runtime verification
